This Week in F-Droid

TWIF curated on Friday, 07 Aug 2026, Week 32

F-Droid core

F-Droid and F-Droid Basic were updated to 2.0-rc0, you know the deal, changelog is short. If this is news to you and you didn’t update to any 2.0 development builds yet, hello and welcome, so many things have changed, you’ll just have to experience it. Navigate to the F-Droid or Basic app details page, check “Allow beta updates” in the top right three dot menu, and update.
